what_the_snapshots_actually_are.structure: Each file is a LIST of market records. Keys: cutoffAt, isAlternate, key, limits, matchupId, period, prices, status, type, version.
what_the_snapshots_actually_are.interpretation: These are 17 CROSS-MATCHUP board snapshots (~70 different matchups each), not 17 time-series captures of one market. There is no repeated market, so line MOVEMENT is not measurable from this archive at all.

DATA_QUALITY_DEFECT_3_of_17_files_are_au.why_it_matters: An HTTP 401 response body was saved into the snapshot directory as though it were market data. Any loader that does not check status will silently treat these as empty boards. If they were ever included in an average, they would drag it toward zero without raising.
DATA_QUALITY_DEFECT_3_of_17_files_are_au.action: Any snapshot loader MUST reject records where status != 200 or type == 'about:blank', and MUST count rejected files in the run report.

reasons.clv: CLV needs (locked price, closing price, outcome). There are no settled picks and no outcomes in this archive.
reasons.line_movement: Zero matchups appear in more than one file (0 of 911), so there is no before/after pair to difference.
